title: Troupe config.yaml, version 1
description: The user's config.yaml, a project's .troupe/config.yaml and .troupe/config.local.yaml. Generated from Troupe.Config.Schema by mix troupe.config.schema; do not edit.

version.description: The version of this format. A file without it is version 1.

$schema.description: Where an editor finds this schema. Troupe does not read it.

provider.description: The session-wide provider's API. Read from a project's file only in a trusted workspace.

base_url.description: The session-wide provider's URL. Unset: the vendor's own endpoint. Read from a project's file only in a trusted workspace.

api_key.description: The session-wide provider's key. `{env:VAR}` reads it from the environment. Read from a project's file only in a trusted workspace.

auth.description: How the key is sent: the vendor's own header, or `Authorization: Bearer`. Read from a project's file only in a trusted workspace.

providers.description: Named providers. A model spelled `<provider>/<model>` goes to that provider. Read from a project's file only in a trusted workspace.

type.description: The API it speaks. A gateway such as LiteLLM or vLLM is `openai`.

base_url.description: Where it is. Unset: the vendor's own endpoint.

api_key.description: Its key. `{env:VAR}` reads it from the environment.

auth.description: How the key is sent: the vendor's own header, or `Authorization: Bearer`.

models.description: The models it serves, by the name Troupe addresses them with.

id.description: The id that goes on the wire, when the gateway renamed the model. Unset: the name.

context.description: The model's context window, in tokens.

max_output.description: The most output tokens to ask for.

reasoning_effort.description: How hard the model should think: `none`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, or a thinking budget in tokens.

auth_token.description: Old spelling of api_key with auth: bearer.

default.description: The model every agent uses unless its definition names one.

cheap.description: The model for small jobs, compaction summaries among them. Unset: the default model.

expensive.description: The model an agent asking for `expensive` gets. Unset: the default model.

windows.description: Context windows for bare model ids, in tokens.

max_tokens.description: The most output tokens one model call asks for.

context_window.description: The window assumed when neither a provider nor the catalog says.

compact_at.description: The share of the window at which an agent summarises older turns.

llm_timeout_ms.description: How long one model call may take before it is given up on.

max_turns.description: Model calls an agent may make.

max_input_tokens.description: Input tokens an agent may spend.

max_output_tokens.description: Output tokens an agent may spend.

wall_clock_ms.description: How long an agent may run.

max_depth.description: How deep agents may delegate; 1 means the root alone may.

budget_warn_at.description: The share of any limit at which the agent is warned.

budget_asks.description: A spent budget asks the person attached, rather than stopping.

auto_approve.description: Run every tool call without asking. Read from a project's file only in a trusted workspace.

approvals.description: What a call that asks does with nobody attached: wait, or be denied. Read from a project's file only in a trusted workspace.

managed_permission_rules_only.description: A session may not allow a tool for itself. Read from a project's file only in a trusted workspace.

managed_mcp_servers_only.description: A client may not offer a session its own tools. Read from a project's file only in a trusted workspace.

shell_timeout_ms.description: How long a shell command may run.

tool_output_limit.description: Bytes of a tool's output the model sees.

read_roots.description: Directories outside the workspace the read tools may reach. Read from a project's file only in a trusted workspace.

mcp.description: The workspace's own MCP servers, by name. Read from a project's file only in a trusted workspace.

command.description: A server on its standard streams: the program to run.

cd.description: The directory to run it in. Unset: the workspace.

url.description: A server over HTTP: its URL.

timeout_ms.description: How long one call may take.

watch_debounce_ms.description: How long watch mode waits for writes to settle.

watch_poll_interval_ms.description: How often watch mode polls where it cannot be told.

fs_events.description: Record every file change in the workspace as an event.

fs_debounce_ms.description: How long file events wait for writes to settle.

default_agent.description: The agent a session starts with.

resume_on_restart.description: A session that comes back after a restart carries on by itself.

loop_max_failures.description: Failed turns in a row that stop a loop.

memory.description: Agents read and write the project brief, `.troupe/memory.md`.

memory_auto_refresh.description: A new session refreshes a missing or stale brief.

memory_max_chars.description: How much of the brief goes into a prompt.

memory_max_age_days.description: How old the brief may be before it counts as stale.

trusted_workspaces.description: Workspaces whose own files may set the keys marked trusted. A path trusts everything under it. Read only from the user's config.yaml.

state_dir.description: Where session logs go. Unset: the platform's state directory. Read from a project's file only in a trusted workspace.

fake_script.description: With `provider: fake`, the file of scripted answers. Read from a project's file only in a trusted workspace.

mouse.description: The terminal UI captures the mouse.

auth_token.description: Old spelling of api_key with auth: bearer. Read from a project's file only in a trusted workspace.
